text:
maria: FYI: rolling out new per-route quota model + invoice clarity changes on 2026-06-01. This affects free tier and small-paid accounts. Details: https://redwood.example.com/docs/billing/quota-model-2026 :loudspeaker:

maria: TL;DR: replace blanket monthly free tokens with per-route quota buckets and explicit "burst_token_grant" entries. This gives apps more predictable routing and lets us meter by feature.

dinesh: Quick confirm: will this change any client SDK headers or only billing exports?

maria: Only exports and invoices. We're adding X-Quota-Bucket and X-Quota-Remaining headers for internal debugging on requests; they won't count as breaking SDK changes.

sara: Invoice example please so CS can explain to customers.

billing-bot: Example invoice snippet (new fields):
```
Line items:
- usage.text_generation: 1,250,000 tokens
- burst_token_grant (negative): -500 tokens
- pro_rata_adjustment: -$12.50
Tax and total
```
Note: `burst_token_grant` will appear as a separate negative line when auto-granted.

maria: Important: we're also standardizing overage notifications. Customers will get an email when they hit 85% of a quota bucket, and a second when they hit 100%. Support playbook linked in doc.

cs: We'll need canned replies. Also request a one-pager for AMs to explain tradeoffs for Dedicated vs using per-route quotas.

sara: I'll draft canned replies. Proposed short blurb: "We've moved to per-route quota buckets so teams can control which endpoints consume their monthly allowance. This reduces noisy overages caused by shared free tokens." Thoughts?

dinesh: Ops: monitor for edge-case spikes after cutover. We'll enable an alert for unexpected invoice crediting patterns.

infra: Note: metric `billing.quota.bucket_usage` will be emitted with new tag `quota_model:per-route`. Expect modest cardinality increase.

maria: Rollout plan: 2026-06-01 enable exports & alerts; 2026-07-01 default enforcement of hard caps for free tier. We'll keep a 30-day soft enforcement window for paid plans.

cs: Any refunds/credits policy for customers who hit unexpected overages during migration?

maria: We'll evaluate case-by-case. Adding a `pro_rata_adjustment` item for manual credits so finance can record them cleanly. Customers should open tickets with billing@redwood.com and include invoice id.

sara: Scheduling a 15-min sync with CS + AMs + Support ops tomorrow to review messaging.

billing-bot: Reminder: billing export column names change on rollout: `route_name` -> `quota_bucket`, `free_tokens` removed. Update billing ETL jobs.

maria: Thanks everyone. Ping me for a short slide deck for customer calls. End thread."
